name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Raven goes with exactly two of Sable, Cleric, and Rapier.
Rapier goes with none of Fenwick, Rogue, or Hawk.
Sable goes with Rapier if and only if Cleric goes with Fenwick.
Between Druid and Rogue, one goes with Quarterstaff and the other with Rapier.
Either Fenwick goes with Rogue or Hawk goes with Druid.
